identity.remote_verification_scope: Root verified immutable remote bytes. This local runner checks SHA256 and Git blob SHA1 against that receipt; it does not perform a network verification.

publication.verification_scope: Coordinator verified immutable remote bytes; this runner verifies local SHA256 and Git blob SHA1 against the signed-off receipt, without network access.

scope: Post-result engineering verification only. Original numerical failures, primary utility table, candidate conclusions and all frozen files remain unchanged.
